visual_observation: Rendered product card prominently uses an urgency callout with a clock emoji and red-accent presentation.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the card says "Midnight Flash Sale", "Limited-time price", "Featured listing", and "⏰ Act now — Don’t miss out on this price!"; the callout has role=button and red border/text classes.
transition_observation: Scoped click on the urgency role=button changed its computed background from rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.12) to the observed post-click state while leaving the text and card structure unchanged; scoped Add to cart click produced no DOM/text transition.
justification: The rendered listing combines a limited-time claim and explicit pressure to act now, with the pressure callout presented as an interactive control; this is sufficient evidence of urgency-driven deceptive design.

visual_observation: Rendered newsletter card makes the discount CTA prominent and presents the opt-out as a subdued underlined line.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the card offers "Get 10% off your first order" and a primary button "Yes, claim my 10% discount"; the opt-out is a pointer cursor span reading "No, thanks — I’ll pay full price" rather than a peer button.
transition_observation: Scoped click on the opt-out span produced no DOM/text transition; the opt-out remained present and the primary discount button remained available.
justification: The opt-out copy frames declining as paying full price while the affirmative discount action is the prominent button, which is sufficient evidence of confirmshaming/deceptive choice framing.

visual_observation: Rendered account card presents ordinary account details and a clearly labeled destructive action without promotional pressure or competing choices.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the screen is headed "Account settings" and shows the account email, membership date, Pro plan, and a single button labeled "Delete account" with no euphemistic or coercive copy.
transition_observation: Scoped click on the Delete account button produced no DOM/text transition; the account details and button remained unchanged.
justification: The action is explicitly named and presented in a straightforward settings card, with no observed urgency, confirmshaming, hidden opt-out, or misleading choice framing.
condition_ledger: no pressure or coercive alternative observed

visual_observation: Rendered pricing card clearly displays the fiat amount, annual billing period, VAT inclusion, and a separate conversion control.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the screen labels the plan "Annual plan — billed yearly", shows "PLN 149.00 / year, VAT incl.", and states it is priced directly in fiat; a button offers conversion to USD/EUR.
transition_observation: Scoped click on "Convert to USD / EUR" produced no DOM/text transition; the fiat amount and explanatory text remained unchanged.
justification: The price and billing interval are explicit, tax inclusion is stated, and currency conversion is offered without hidden costs or pressure language.

visual_observation: Rendered permission card presents one prominent red contact-access action and no visible secondary refusal or defer control.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the copy says "Find your friends on PopSocial" and explains that contact access is used to find existing friends; the only interactive element is a button labeled "Allow access to contacts".
transition_observation: Scoped click on the contact-access button produced no DOM/text transition and no additional consent detail or alternative appeared.
justification: The purpose of contact access is stated, but the single-choice presentation lacks a visible decline/defer path; the DOM alone does not resolve whether this is ordinary onboarding or a privacy-manipulative prompt.

visual_observation: Rendered standard product card states the price and a time-bound offer plainly, with a conventional green Add to cart button and no separate urgency control.
dom_observation: Within [data-isolated-demo], the listing is marked "Standard listing" and states "Limited-time price on wireless earbuds — ends tonight." alongside "$29.99, was $59.99" and one Add to cart button.
transition_observation: Scoped click on Add to cart produced no DOM/text transition; the listing remained unchanged.
justification: The time-bound offer is stated as ordinary product copy, the listing is explicitly standard, and there is no interactive pressure banner, shaming, or hidden choice observed.
candidate_screen: Midnight Flash Sale standard product listing
